notes.title: New Game Announcement! "Void Inside" page is already available on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Void Inside[/b] is a first-person psychological horror that immerses you in a supernatural reality. Remotely resembling the human world, this place is filled with horrifying entities incomprehensible to the human mind. Your goal is to survive and maintain your sanity

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wbWXK7AGhQU

[i][b]Add a game to your wishlist![/b][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2015450/Void_Inside

notes.content:
Vote Uninvited Guest for the CryEngine Game of the Year 2021:
https://forum.cryengine.com/viewtopic.php?f=59&t=236248

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41287987/007a638fcc601dbc4d1c44db8bfb5f97ce445ac9.png[/img]
